notes.title: We Finally Have A Name! - C-Beams Devlog #38
notes.content:
Test test is this thing on? It's my first time making a steam event post, Hopefully, I'm doing this right.

The 38th Devlog for C-Beams is now live on YouTube!

In this devlog we discuss why the game is named C-Beams, the artists who helped create our announcement trailer, new spaceships coming into the game, and the first look at our game's tutorial system.
